post.title: How do global apps handle comments without freezing? They avoid immediate... | Eventual Consistency
post.subtitle:
How do massive global apps like social networks handle millions of comments simultaneously? If they waited for every server to agree, the app would freeze. 🛠️

Learn how to master Eventual Consistency Explained in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- How do global apps handle comments without freezing? They avoid immediate agreement.
- Eventual Consistency lets servers accept updates instantly and sync asynchronously.
- Given time without new updates, all replicas eventually converge to the same value.
- Databases resolve conflicts using Last-Write-Wins or CRDT merge strategies.
